decision_conditions:
The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years from the date of the original Planning Permission; ref: 18/3575/FUL.
REASON: To conform with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004
description: Demolition of existing garage. Erection of two x 2 storey five bed single-family dwellings with basement and associated hard and soft landscaping, new boundary treatment and refuse and cycle provision. Creation of dropped kerbs to facilitate provision of off-street parking. (Variation of condition U0155907 of planning approval 18/3575/FUL dated 31 August 2023 to allow for reduction to basements and lightwells, changes to elevations and fenestration, 2no. air source heat pumps, landscaping changes, and re-location of PV panels from rear roof slope to side roof slope).
